text: Great product!  I am a female and have sparse, light brown/blond brows. A few tips:  Open the capsule by cutting with cuticle scissors. Pour the powder into a clean contact lens case. Don't use the litle cup, something sturdy is better, I used a little cough medicine cup. Use your own brush, the one provided was a bit stiff (to me) I used a smaller, softer brush. Tap out a tiny bit into your cup, add equal liquid developer, mix well. Do this on a piece of newspaper and have some qtips ready. Carefully apply it, as though putting on your usual eyebrow make up. If you get some out of your line, dab it with a qtip asap, no skin staining that way.  Try 2 minutes. Have dark, wet wash cloth waiting also.  Wipe. Look (while it dries) I did it 3 times (didn't want to be shocked) I wanted a dark look and achieved this easily. Figure out your own time. On the 2nd time, I did the other brow first...that was good. Yes, it stains your skin (which is what you do with make up) so...stain it carefully and be glad!  No irritation. Love this!
